async def act(page):
    # Click on the 'Reports' link to navigate to the reports section
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Reports").click()
    # Wait for the page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Look for a link to 'Products' or 'Bestsellers' report
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("link", name="Products").click()
    except:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("link", name="Bestsellers").click()
        except:
            # If not found, try 'Sales' report
            await page.get_by_role("link", name="Sales").first.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Set date range to 2022
    # Look for date input fields or comboboxes
    try:
        # Try to fill custom date fields
        await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="From").fill("2022-01-01")
        await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="To").fill("2022-12-31")
    except:
        # If no textboxes, try to select a year option from a combobox
        await page.get_by_role("combobox").filter(has=page.get_by_text("Year")).select_option("2022")
    # Wait for the report to update
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Extract the top product from the report table
    # Assume the top product is in the first row after the header
    top_product_cell = page.get_by_role("table").get_by_role("rowgroup").get_by_role("row").nth(1).get_by_role("cell").first
    top_product_name = await top_product_cell.text_content()
    return top_product_name
